plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp boxing build with three full-body sessions each week using bodyweight-only training. Week 1 establishes simple performance baselines on the main lifts so the next weeks can progress cleanly, and the main program starts in Week 2. The emphasis is general strength first, then power and repeatable conditioning, while keeping impact and technical demands beginner-friendly.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic full-body strength, simple explosive ability, and aerobic repeatability with low-equipment work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress harder bodyweight strength variations and denser power-conditioning work while keeping recovery on track.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Turn the new strength into faster, sharper bodyweight power and crisp conditioning without excess fatigue.

exercises.name: 1a. Squat Jump
exercises.notes: Jump fast and land softly. Reset between reps so every jump stays crisp.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if squat jumps feel awkward. Keep the landing quiet and controlled.

exercises.name: 1b. Broad Jump
exercises.notes: Stick each landing for a full second. Stop the set if distance drops off.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump to Stable Surface
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low safe target and step down each rep.

exercises.name: 2. Push-Up
exercises.notes: This session sets your baseline for future progress. Use strict reps only with a straight body and full range.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log your best strict set and stop before form breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: After a few easy warm-up sets, perform one hard top set of strict push-ups and stop with about one clean rep left. Log the rep total to set your starting point.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use hands on a bench, box, or sturdy surface if floor push-ups are not yet clean.

exercises.name: 3. Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use a controlled lower and stand up hard. Keep the front foot flat and torso tall.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if split squats are more comfortable to balance.

exercises.name: 4. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Keep hips high and ribs down. Hold a straight line from head to heel.

substitutionOptions.name: Front Plank
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if side planks irritate the shoulder.

exercises.name: 5. Mountain Climber Intervals
exercises.notes: Move continuously for conditioning. Keep hands planted and hips steady.

endurancePrescription.rest: 30 seconds easy standing or slow march

exercises.name: 1a. Pogo Jump
exercises.notes: Stay tall and springy off the floor. Keep contact time short and quiet.

substitutionOptions.name: Line Hop
substitutionOptions.notes: Use small quick hops if pogos feel too bouncy.

exercises.name: 1b. Push-Up to Shoulder Tap
exercises.notes: Move under control and keep the hips from shifting. Use smooth, clean reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up to Shoulder Tap
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a higher hand position if floor reps lose body control.

exercises.name: 2. Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.reps: AMRAP each side with 1 rep in reserve
exercises.notes: This session sets your lower-body baseline. Use bodyweight only and stop before balance or depth breaks down.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log reps on each side with clean depth and control.

strengthAssessment.prompt: After easy build-up sets, perform one hard set on each side and stop with about one clean rep left. Log reps per side to set your starting point.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you do not have a stable rear-foot support.

exercises.name: 3. Table Row
exercises.notes: Pull the chest toward the edge and keep the body straight. Use a sturdy setup only.

substitutionOptions.name: Doorway Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a secure towel or strap setup only if it is fully stable.

substitutionOptions.name: Prone Snow Angel
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if no safe row setup is available. Move slowly and squeeze the upper back.

exercises.name: 4. Reverse Crunch
exercises.notes: Curl the pelvis up instead of swinging the legs. Lower under control.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if reverse crunches cause low-back discomfort.

exercises.name: 5. Tempo Shadowboxing
exercises.notes: Keep the feet active and the hands sharp. Breathe through the rounds.
